<?php
/** Test only: a bank that approves every payment, standing in for ZarinPal, which can't be reached from the test machine. */
add_filter('woocommerce_payment_gateways', function ($gateways) {
    if (!class_exists('Takav_Test_Bank')) {
        class Takav_Test_Bank extends WC_Payment_Gateway {
            public function __construct() {
                $this->id = 'takav_test_bank';
                $this->method_title = $this->title = 'درگاه آزمایشی';
                $this->description = 'فقط برای آزمایش.';
                $this->enabled = 'yes';
            }
            public function process_payment($order_id) {
                $order = wc_get_order($order_id);
                $order->payment_complete('TEST-' . $order_id);
                WC()->cart->empty_cart();
                return array('result' => 'success', 'redirect' => $this->get_return_url($order));
            }
        }
    }
    $gateways[] = 'Takav_Test_Bank';
    return $gateways;
});
